name: What happens if my car is declared a total loss after a San Diego car accident?

mainEntity.name: What happens if my car is declared a total loss after a San Diego car accident?

acceptedAnswer.text: If repair costs exceed your vehicle’s value, it’s deemed a total loss. You are entitled to the fair market value of your car before the accident, which insurance should pay for replacement.seriousaccidents+1​
